{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check how many severe patients have biomarker_baseline = -999.0
severe_with_sentinel = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding sentinel values
mean_baseline_severe = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print results
print("Number of SEVERE patients:", len(severe_patients))
print("Number of SEVERE patients with sentinel value (-999.0):", len(severe_with_sentinel))
print("Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values):"," , mean_baseline_severe)"}}
